concern_summary: Handling of money request reports, ensuring user interactions for approvals, payments, and visibility of relevant details are effectively managed based on report status.
This concern focuses on managing user navigation flow when exiting the report screen, determining the appropriate actions based on user interactions and context.

This concern relates to the functionality of the report screen by aggregating the processes involved in displaying complete reports and checking for any associated transaction violations for a given report ID.
This concern highlights the management of loading states and user feedback mechanisms, ensuring the Report Screen provides clear indicators during data loading and interaction.
Concern validating report IDs and managing states allowing write actions and data readiness.
Relates to financial transactions and billing, focusing on determining and updating the status of transactions, purchase bills, and subscription payments to provide appropriate user feedback.

This concern covers the functionalities related to creating a frozen screen state within the report screen, including preventing user interactions and displaying a lazy-loaded component until it is fully ready.
This concern focuses on the onboarding report functionality, which checks the availability of reports for new users and directs them to the appropriate chat or report route.
